events.title: Endless Mode, Controller and Steam Deck support, Veindex. Endless Mode!!!
events.summary: I added an endless mode to the demo! The plan for the final game is to add multiple endless modes that revolve around different mechanics of the game. This current one enables you to repair hull by collecting red minerals and refuel by collecting meteorite, a mineral you will only find very late in the main game.I'm super curious what your highscores are, feel free to post screenshots here!Also I added controller support, so all requirements for Steam Deck support are now fulfilled! I'm curious

events.title: Localization added!
events.summary: I added localization capabilities!In addition to English, Veinrider is now also available in German, French, Spanish, Chinese (simplified), Korean and Japanese. I added pretty dynamic localisation functionality and adding more languages will now be less work, namely the actual translations.Have fun and let me know how you like it if you're playing in any of the new languages!

events.title: Major Demo Update!
events.summary: The demo received a massive overhaul! The game just got bigger and better in most regards, here’s what changed:♦ Much smoother performance — the heavy GPU usage has been fixed ♦ Visual overhaul across the game ♦ Two new biomes to explore ♦ A small surprise waiting deeper in the caves Please note: Because the upgrade tree and overall progression were redesigned, existing demo save files will reset when launching this version.Thank you for all the feedback so far — it was invaluable to this update

events.title: Veinrider Demo Now Available
events.summary: The Veinrider demo is now available on Steam.Explore alien caverns, flip gravity to survive tight spaces, and collect resources to upgrade your ship between runs.More content and improvements are planned for future updates. Feedback is welcome!
